deployments_detail.use: SmartStreet research project (with University of Innsbruck) using AI to predict material properties when recycled materials are mixed into asphalt and concrete before production

SmartStreet research project: a neural network predicts the mechanical properties of asphalt and concrete when recycled material is added, replacing physical sample testing to optimise recycled content. [University of Innsbruck (Dept. of Materials Technology); funded by Austrian Research Promotion Agency (FFG)]
deployments_detail.value: PORR produces ~1.5 million tonnes of recycled material group-wide; project runs Oct 2025-Oct 2028

deployments_detail.use: AI applied in planning and project development phases of construction projects. [none named]

CRAHOI (Crane Hook Identification): sensor/telemetry-equipped crane hook reads RFID tags on prefab elements and uses machine learning to improve load identification, automating real-time material-handling documentation and BIM/logistics integration. [PORR with partner companies (Liebherr Smart cited in secondary/social coverage)]

QuickSpeech intelligent microlearning platform for employee training (onboarding, product/safety training, apprenticeships, management development); machine learning identifies user needs and adapts learning content to individual patterns. [QuickSpeech GmbH (PORR took a strategic stake)]
AI used in the tax department for over seven years to prepare/automate VAT returns (Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen) across Europe. [none named]
Equipment/fleet telematics: data collected from the group's 60,000+ devices and machines is analysed and made usable for decision-making (maintenance, fleet management, safety access). [none named]
AI-based checking/verification of documents (Pruefung von Unterlagen), with programs that will capture and verify entire plans, protocols and building documentation. [none named]
AI applied in tendering/bid processes (Ausschreibungen) to support proposal and procurement work. [none named]
